_crackheadniko: By the time Walter "Spark" Crackheadnik reached R-C9, the war was 9 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.
aidanthompson0319: Benedikt Aidanthompso came up the line with a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.

Benedikt Aidanthompso hates silence more than shelling. Today, under fire at Lantern Hill, that habit was the only steady thing in R-S6. Mail came up the line with a letter for Benedikt Aidanthompso. Benedikt Aidanthompso read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Benedikt Aidanthompso brushed dried mud off a letter and found one more word under it: 'soon'. He wished the rest of the sentence had survived. Mail came up the line with a letter for Benedikt Aidanthompso. Benedikt Aidanthompso read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
alex._a_2010: On Day 7, Roland "Button" Alex arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.
Roland "Button" Alex sent a pigeon back to headquarters. The pigeon came back two hours later. Roland "Button" Alex took it personally.
Roland "Button" Alex brought sandbags forward and found the damage worse than the message had said. The party went back for another load.
alexj.558: Anselm Alexj came up the line with a key to a house that is no longer there and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.

The rain did not stop once. Anselm Alexj slept standing up, wedged against the wall of S-F2, and dreamt of dry socks. Hill 304 is lost. Anselm Alexj heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Anselm Alexj had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Valentin Bladestalker crossed it, Anselm Alexj fired. Valentin Bladestalker was grazed.
Asked what he will do after the war, Anselm Alexj said: 'Be a clockmaker in Varenne. And never complain about anything, ever again.'
Anselm Alexj of the Concord lobbed a tin of jam over the wire at the Sunken Road. It came back empty, washed, with a flower inside and Zeno Smiridisnick's name scratched on the lid.
An unexploded shell lay beside the approach trench. Anselm Alexj helped steer the carrying party around it and was glad to leave the problem to somebody else.
axelat3: Ulrich Axelat arrived with the evening ration party, carrying his mother's thimble and a borrowed greatcoat two sizes too big.
The colonel shook hands with the first hundred, one by one. Ulrich Axelat was number 28. He still remembers how cold the colonel's glove was.

Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Ulrich Axelat read a theatre review while peeling supper. Victory at Verdel Ridge. Ulrich Axelat let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Ulrich Axelat cut Valentin Zle's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short.
Ulrich Axelat mended a split glove with pale thread. One finger now looks like it has been promoted.

Ulrich Axelat stretched a scrap of canvas over the letters. Everything else could get wet first. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Hill 304. Ulrich Axelat read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Ulrich Axelat of the Concord spotted Zeno Ramsey of the Hegemony repairing a parapet at Verdel Ridge. A warning shot stopped the repair on the spot.
A flare lit Saint-Ash crossroads like noon. Ulrich Axelat counted the seconds until darkness: eleven.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Ulrich Axelat's ear at S-F12 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Norbert Fransinlak of the Hegemony (@fransinlak). Ulrich Axelat was cleaning the rifle when a head showed across the wire. Load, aim, fire. Konrad "Ash" Sapino was grazed.
Ulrich Axelat's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.
heitoralmeida314: They issued Dorian Heitoralmeid a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a tin whistle in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.
jameson.308: At the depot, Arno "Doc" Jameson had practised answering to his name. At R-F21, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.

A sniper's bullet hit Arno "Doc" Jameson at R-F21. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Benedikt Kfg of the Hegemony (@felix.kfg). An orderly waved the bearers in: one bed, cleared and scrubbed. Arno "Doc" Jameson was lifted onto it in the hospital dugout. Arno "Doc" Jameson is out of danger. Still bedridden, still bandaged, but out of danger. A letter from home found Arno "Doc" Jameson before the night shift. Arno "Doc" Jameson folded it small and kept it close.

Arno "Doc" Jameson spent the day in bed with his leg propped up. The orderly changed the dressing and said it was healing the way it should. A letter from home found Arno "Doc" Jameson before the night shift. Arno "Doc" Jameson folded it small and kept it close. The Hegemony took Hill 304. Arno "Doc" Jameson watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Back with his platoon, Arno "Doc" Jameson found that someone had kept his place on the fire step. Nobody admitted who.
Arno "Doc" Jameson checked the duty roster and noticed the same names on the worst shifts. He fetched a fresh sheet of paper and started over.

Arno "Doc" Jameson and Dietrich Jackson tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco. A letter from home found Arno "Doc" Jameson before the night shift. Arno "Doc" Jameson folded it small and kept it close.
A bullet went through Arno "Doc" Jameson's sleeve at R-F21 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Ivo Hohne of the Hegemony (@shawn_hohne).
just_ther758: The sergeant gave Clement Ther a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 9 or any other.
mika_de_roover: Edmund Roover arrived on Day 9 as a replacement. The men in S-R15 had been fighting for 9 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.
s3ba_rp: Pavel Sbarp came from Coldwater, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.
sean_sperring: Quentin "Mud" Sperring stepped off the supply cart at R-F19 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.
Quentin "Mud" Sperring taught Wendel Yaboyslydude to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop.

A football came over the parapet from the Concord side with Quentin "Mud" Sperring's name scratched on it. Karel Check kicked it back. It did not come again. The sergeant read out the order: Hill 304 has fallen, hold the line. Quentin "Mud" Sperring looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
Quentin "Mud" Sperring raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-F19. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Zeno Irl of the Hegemony (@king_baldwin_irl).
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Quentin "Mud" Sperring is whole again, or near enough for the line.
A parcel arrived tied with blue ribbon. Quentin "Mud" Sperring gave the contents away and kept the ribbon to mark a page.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Quentin "Mud" Sperring in the open at R-F19. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Ivo Hohne of the Hegemony (@shawn_hohne). Quentin "Mud" Sperring looked over the parapet at R-F19 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Ivo Hohne of the Hegemony (@shawn_hohne).
Karel Sperring put a key to a house that is no longer there beside the bunk. Someone who had known Quentin "Mud" Sperring helped clear the shelf without saying why.
the_cowboii: Tobias "Crow" Cowboii was a baker in Kesselby until the posters went up. He came to S-F14 with a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts, and within a day the whole bay knew that he collects shell fuses.
Tobias "Crow" Cowboii received the First Wave ribbon. He checked the stitching twice before putting the tunic back on.
Tobias "Crow" Cowboii cut his hand to the bone on the wire at the Bone Quarry. Iodine, a bandage, and a lecture from the medic.

Tobias "Crow" Cowboii's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it. Verdel Ridge has been won. Tobias "Crow" Cowboii listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

Tobias "Crow" Cowboii had Severin Lagbagdotzip of the Hegemony in the sights at the Chalk Pits for a long second. Severin Lagbagdotzip was lighting a pipe. Tobias "Crow" Cowboii let the match burn all the way down.
Tobias "Crow" Cowboii and Yann Spring carved a chessboard into an ammunition box. The pieces are bullets, buttons and one very patient beetle.

A pocket watch went along the bench so everyone could set the time. Tobias "Crow" Cowboii has no watch, but checked it anyway, just to feel included. Hill 304 is in Hegemony hands. Tobias "Crow" Cowboii stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Tobias "Crow" Cowboii and Edmund Fts compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house.
Tobias "Crow" Cowboii raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-F14. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Silas Menezes of the Hegemony (@julio.menezes921).
Tobias "Crow" Cowboii rejoined the squad at S-F14. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.

A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-F14 and grazed Tobias "Crow" Cowboii's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Silas Menezes of the Hegemony (@julio.menezes921). Tobias "Crow" Cowboii fired once through the steel loophole at S-F14 and closed the shutter before the echo came back. Bram "Ghost" Dravci was grazed.
zoric_nikola011: The quartermaster asked Karel "Button" Nikola to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included. Karel "Button" Nikola reported for duty as a rifleman. The new kit was heavier than the explanation of how to use it.
Karel "Button" Nikola had Marek Izu of the Hegemony in the sights at Hill 304 for a long second. Marek Izu was lighting a pipe. Karel "Button" Nikola let the match burn all the way down.

Karel "Button" Nikola laughed at something nobody else had heard. Asked to share it, he admitted remembering a conversation from years ago. The Hegemony took Hill 304. Karel "Button" Nikola watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools. Karel "Button" Nikola left the work of a rifleman to become a machine gunner. Someone from the old section came over to see how it was going.

Jakub Nistico wrote a letter for Karel "Button" Nikola's mother, because Button could not find the words. Button signed it. A letter from home found Karel "Button" Nikola before the night shift. Karel "Button" Nikola folded it small and kept it close.
Karel "Button" Nikola accepted promotion to Lance Corporal. Later, he practised giving the morning orders quietly enough not to wake the dugout.
A single shot from across the wire hit Karel "Button" Nikola in the thigh at R-F20. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Marek Dream of the Hegemony (@initial_dream8.6).
The bearers moved Karel "Button" Nikola's stretcher against the wall at midday and back again at dusk. That was the whole schedule.
